DiffResult.description: The difference between two runs, over findings that need action.
DiffResult.title: DiffResult

DomainFont.description: A font used on one domain, with how it was embedded and the hosts it was seen on.
DomainFont.title: DomainFont

DomainReport.description: The domain-centric view of a scan: one target domain and what was found on it.
DomainReport.title: DomainReport

EmbeddingMethod.description: How a font is delivered to the page.
EmbeddingMethod.title: EmbeddingMethod

FamilySpec.description:
Match a font by family name: contains every substring in `contains_all`
(case-insensitive) and none in `excludes`. Empty `contains_all` never matches.
FamilySpec.title: FamilySpec

Finding.description: A classified font identity: the unit of a report (ADR 0003, deterministic).
Finding.title: Finding

FindingDelta.description: A finding present in both runs whose verdict or domain spread changed.
FindingDelta.title: FindingDelta

FontMetadata.description: Fields read from a font file's `name` table (any may be missing/stripped).
FontMetadata.title: FontMetadata

HostAsset.description: The font-file URL(s) a font was served from on one host.
HostAsset.title: HostAsset

LicenseVerdict.description:
Deterministic license classification (ADR 0003). Nuance lives in the reason.

OK          — no action needed: covered by a registry license, provably open,
              or a system/fallback font (no license question).
NEEDS_CHECK  — the honest default: no license on record and not provably open;
              a human should look. Carries evidence notes explaining why.
VIOLATION    — a definite lapse: a declared license expired or out of scope /
              over max_domains, a paid tier served without cover, or a
              self-host-prohibited font self-hosted without cover.
LicenseVerdict.title: LicenseVerdict

PrivacyClass.description:
How a font's delivery affects visitor privacy — the axis is independent of
the license risk band. Third-party delivery (e.g. the Google Fonts API) sends
each visitor's IP to that third party, a GDPR/RODO concern even when the font
itself is freely licensed.
PrivacyClass.title: PrivacyClass

RegistryImportResult.description:
Result of a registry import: the merged registry, per-row errors (CSV only),
and how the merge changed what was already there — replacements are reported
because an import can silently *loosen* an entry (e.g. drop its expiry).
RegistryImportResult.title: RegistryImportResult

RulesConfig.description: Classification data for the verdict engine (editable without touching code).
RulesConfig.title: RulesConfig

RunReport.description: A complete scan run: the JSON source of truth that every output derives from.
RunReport.title: RunReport

RunSummary.description: Headline counts for one scan run.
RunSummary.title: RunSummary
